It currently plays in the second tier of Czech football. In the 1996–97, 1997–98 and 1998–99 seasons, the club played in the [[Czech 2. Liga]]. In the 2011–12 season, Česká Lípa was a [[farm team]] for Czech 3. Liga side [[FK Baník Most]].{{cite news |last=Havlen|first=Michael|title=Česká Lípa je farmou fotbalového Mostu, Jablonec ji nakonec odmítl|url=https://www.idnes.cz/fotbal/domaci-souteze/ceska-lipa-je-farmou-fotbaloveho-mostu-jablonec-ji-nakonec-odmitl.A110712_1617077_fot_dsouteze_ten|language=cs|work=[[iDNES.cz]]|date=12 July 2011 |accessdate=23 August 2011|publisher=[[Mafra (company)|Mafra]]}} In 2025–26 season, they won the [[Bohemian Football League]] and were promoted to the [[2026–27 Czech National Football League]].{{cite news |last=Mohr|first=Daniel|url=https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/fotbal-cfl-msfl/fotbal-cfl-baraz-o-druhou-ligu-arsenal-ceska-lipa-kladno-lipa-slavi-titul-oslavy/ |title=Foto: Návrat domů okořenily oslavy.
